required_findings.finding: Current installed publish path calls driver.provision_sources and connection.connect discovers Docker credentials then changes superuser session identity. It is not a reusable authority boundary for this new workflow.
required_findings.correction: Accept separately established source/consumer registrations and ordinary connection/session ports or explicit injected secret-handle configuration. Independently admit source identity, native installation/writer custody and ACK rights; configuration and public UMF proof establish none of these.

required_findings.finding: Existing runner has only fresh run; recoverable-loss branch copies policy.active from memory and reopens the original journal within the same Spark process. That is not a public fresh-process resume implementation.
required_findings.correction: Use distinct fresh/resume configuration types and entrypoints. Before submission retain the exact original request, ordered generated/selected effect plan, no-op prior anchors, publication identity/clock, prefix/source/schema state and resource identities. Resume restores/adopts only those original bytes through owning ports and renews all authority. Never synthesize replacement intent or initialize when an original journal/operation is missing.

required_findings.finding: Historical admission requires exact UMF e44cd15f336dfb33db35acf20eee13dd120a1a28 and the separately authored Field35 presence candidate; ordinary original-commerce producer uses a different pin.
required_findings.correction: Define a separate immutable selected evolution producer/resource profile with explicit executable paths, finite bounds and opening/closing source/runtime custody. Freshly invoke public complete dataset/evolution inspectors plus expected-source verifiers against the actual supplied/pinned inputs. No latest-version substitution or shadow compatibility validator.

required_findings.finding: Eight-publication acceptance includes all source-qualified current/history/tombstone cells, independent progress, exact replay, retained R1 and narrowly admitted R3-to-R4 carriers; final counts alone are insufficient.
required_findings.correction: Retain the original named augmentations and complete per-prefix oracle; add only the source/epoch envelope qualification with exact original event-byte preservation. Breaking model validity does not admit a data migration. Do not collapse edge identity, null/absence or lexical numeric content.

required_findings.finding: Legacy tool close_resources in finally can replace a body failure, and its direct final report write lacks staged availability semantics. Copying the tool would regress reviewed host lifecycle behavior.
required_findings.correction: Capture original primary immediately, acquire/own each connection/transport/Spark resource under cleanup coverage, attempt every cleanup, preserve cancellation identity and separately record cleanup uncertainty. Publish an aggregate report only after closing admission and successful closure, using bounded exclusive staged output. A report failure does not undo an already committed publication or ACK.
